Name: DE-ExpenseSheets
Description: Extracts expense sheets for integration purposes.
Statement:
select  exp.Oid as ExpenseSheetId, 
        exp.DocumentNumber as ExpenseSheet,
        exp.Number as ExpenseSheetNumber,
        exp.ExternalName,
        exp.ExternalError,
        exp.Emission,
        exp.Due,
        exp.Exchange,
        exp.Blocked,
        exp.Paid,
        exp.PaidValue,
        exp.ValueWithVat,
        exp.ValueWithoutVat,
        exp.VatValue,
        com.Name as Company,
        com.Id as CompanyId,
        exp.CreatedOnUtc,
        exp.ModifiedOnUtc,
        cre.Name as CreatedByName,
        mod.Name as ModifiedByName,
        cre.Id as CreatedById,
        mod.Id as ModifiedById
from    Expense exp 
            join CompanyLookup com on com.Id = exp.Company 
            left join UserLookup cre on cre.Id = exp.CreatedBy 
            left join UserLookup mod on mod.Id = exp.ModifiedBy
